title: Retrieval benchmark suite manifest
description: Declares the topics, gold families, splits and provenance of a retrieval evaluation suite. The suite directory must contain this manifest (manifest.json) and run outputs are scored against it by tools/score_retrieval.py. Restricted raw corpora (CLEF-IP, DAPFAM originals) are NEVER bundled - only derived family IDs with license notes.

version.description: Manifest version (semver). Bump on any gold change.

qrels_version.description: Version tag of the relevance judgements; evaluation reports reference this.

gold_completeness.description: Whether gold families are a complete prior-art set. 'pool_biased' means judged only against a pooled candidate set (CLEF-IP-style proxy labels); critical_recall reports must carry the known-incomplete caveat.

license.description: Overall data license / redistribution statement for derived IDs.

provenance.description: Where the topics and gold came from; how they were adjudicated.

families.description: Optional publication_number -> family_id mapping so run files may cite publications. Family IDs must be stable across manifest versions within the same qrels_version.

domain.description: Technology domain tag for slice reporting.

in_domain_of_engine.description: false marks OUT-domain topics for cross-domain transfer evaluation.

gold_families.description: Relevant family IDs (any relevance level). May be empty only when gold_known_incomplete is true and the topic is reported separately (never in the recall denominator).

critical_families.description: Human-confirmed critical prior-art family subset for Critical Prior-art Recall.

relevance_levels.description: family_id -> graded relevance (int, >=0; e.g. 3=blocking, 2=partial, 1=tangential) used by nDCG.

adjudication.description: Who labeled this topic and when (EX-01 requires at least two reviewers for the private expert set).

time_split_key.description: Filing/publication date used for chronological splits (anti-leakage, blueprint §12).
